nodes.title: Character isolation
widgets_values:
Use this group to isolate a single character from your pose reference image. This character will be later used to generate the pose data.

We use Meta's SAM3 for high quality object isolation. It requires Pytorch, CUDA and Triton to work, and some extra Python libraries for the ComfyUI portable version, you can find those libraries and a complete guide in:
[Triton for windows](https://github.com/woct0rdho/triton-windows?tab=readme-ov-file#8-special-notes-for-comfyui-with-embeded-python)  

Use the "prompt" field from the "SAM3 Segmentation" node to shortly describe the character you want to isolate.
Examples:
- Woman
- Dancer
- Man

If your pose reference image happens to have for example, 3 women, or 3 dancers, their index will appear in the "MASKS PREVIEW" image; you can then select a single one by selecting its index in the "SAM3 Segmentation" node, in the object_ids field.
Examples:
- You want to select character 0, you write ```0```
- You want to select characters 1 and 3, you write ```1,3```
- You want to select all the objects/characters matching your prompt, you leave the field blank
You can delete this node, it sends a system notification when the workflow has finished executing, but it needs to be set up.
Don't forget to disable the optional control net groups if you disable the main Controlnet group, otherwise you will hit an error.

nodes.title: INSTRUCTIONS
widgets_values:
## General Notes
- **Yellow nodes** → configurable  
- **Red nodes** → instructions and helpful notes  

---

## Base Settings

- Select your base image resolution and orientation in the **"Image Size Selector"** node.  
- Select your sampling steps. This setting affects all samplers. The workflow handles the math automatically, so you don’t need to worry about each generation stage—just use the number of steps you normally use.  
  - Official recommendation: **8 steps** (but feel free to experiment).  
- If you are using the upscaler, select the target resolution in the **"UPSCALER RESOLUTION"** node.  
- If you are using LoRAs:
  - Activate only the slots you need  
  - Select the LoRA  
  - Adjust the strength  

---

## Global LoRA ControlNet Strength Calibration

1. Fix the seed using the **"EasyGlobalSeed"** node.  
2. Enable the **"ControlNet"** group.  
3. Near the top of the workflow, enable the **"LoRA test"** group.  

4. Set **"CONTROLNET LORA HOOK STRENGTH"** to **0** and run the workflow.  
   - Check the result in the **"CNET PREVIEW"** node.  
   - This shows ControlNet without LoRAs applied.  

5. Set **"CONTROLNET LORA HOOK STRENGTH"** to **1** and run again.  
   - This shows ControlNet with full LoRA influence.  
   - The image will likely look distorted, washed out, or morphed.  

6. Adjust **"CONTROLNET LORA HOOK STRENGTH"** until you find a good balance:
   - The image follows the ControlNet pose  
   - The character/style remains recognizable  
   - The image quality is acceptable  

**Important:**  
The ControlNet stage only *guides* the generation. The main sampler applies the final details and full LoRA styling.  
So the ControlNet result does **not** need to look perfect—just structurally correct.

**Tip:**  
Start at **1.0** and decrease in steps of **0.1** until likeness starts degrading too much.

**Recommended value:** `0.5`

⚠️ **Don't forget to disable the "LoRA test" group after calibration.**

---

## Smoothness Control

The **"SMOOTHNESS LEVEL"** node controls image smoothness.

- Set to **1.0** → maximum smoothness  
- Lower values → more detail  

**Recommended value:** `0.60`  
(but depends on ControlNet and LoRAs used)

⚠️ If set too low, artifacts may appear. Avoid overdoing it.

---

## Prompt Guidelines

- When using ControlNet:
  - Describe the character, pose, and facial expression **as if you were not using LoRAs or ControlNet at all**  
  - This helps the model better align LoRA and pose guidance  

- Use the **"DEFAULT IMAGE FEATURES"** textbox for reusable prompt elements  
  - Leave empty if not needed  

---

## Seed Control

Use the **"EasyGlobalSeed"** node to control the entire workflow seed.

This allows you to:
- Fix a global seed  
- Enable workflow stages one by one  
- Avoid regenerating everything while preserving previous results  

---

## Workflow Control

- Use the **"MAIN GROUPS"** fast group bypasser to enable/disable groups as needed  

---

## Main Groups

### ControlNet
- Enable this group to activate ControlNet guidance  
- Select the ControlNet type using **"CONTROLNET TYPE SELECTOR"**  
- Set the pose reference image in **"POSE REFERENCE IMAGE"**  
- Adjust strength in **"ZImageFunControlnet"**  
  - Default: **0.90** (recommended sweet spot)

#### Optional Features (via "ControlNet optional features")
- **Pose character isolator** → isolate subjects (see group instructions)  
- **Flip pose image** → horizontal/vertical flip  
- **Force standard aspect ratio**  
  - Crops image to selected ratio  
  - Use **"position field"** to control crop area  

---

### Detail Daemon
- Adds extra detail to the image  
- Controlled via **"DETAIL AMOUNT"**

---

### Color Correction
- Adjust brightness, contrast, and saturation  

---

### Noise
- Adds noise for a more natural, "amateur photo" look  

---

### SeedVR Upscaler
- Enable to upscale using **SeedVR2**  
- In **"SeedVR2 (Down)Load DiT Model"**, select the model for your setup  
  - Default: **7B fp16**  
  - Quantized versions available  

**Note:**  
The model downloads automatically on first run. Check the console for progress.

---

### LoRA Sampling
- Enables LoRA influence during generation  
- If disabled → image is generated **without LoRAs**  

⚠️ Requirements:
- Add LoRAs in the slots on the left  
- Activate only the slots you need  
- Ensure **"LoRA sampling"** group is enabled
